review_material.design_summary: The case exposes a single control (detuning delta) and a single readout (effective detuning delta_eff). The two worlds differ in whether an interface correction is present: the statistical-interface world includes a correction term, while the homogeneous baseline world does not. The Player must determine the relationship between delta and delta_eff experimentally.
